correctness.rationale: Starting from the published Harris--Tu/Friedland--Krattenthaler product, direct cancellation gives \(D_{n,r-1}D_{n,r+1}/D_{n,r}^2=r(2n-r)/[4(2(n-r)-1)(2(n-r)+1)]\). The sign comparison is algebraically equivalent to \(17(n-r)^2\gtreqless n^2+4\), so there is one monotone transition and equality is the negative Pell equation \(n^2-17(n-r)^2=-4\). Independent exact arithmetic verified the ratio and sign criterion for all interior ranks with \(3\le n\le14\).
